Carla (Mktg): Quick sync — Riverside meetup next Wed: final checklist for booth, speaker slots, swag, and webinar follow-up. Who can own shipping + QR leadflow?
Matt S: I can take shipping. Need final counts by EOD today. What's the final swag list?
Jin L: Speaker submissions closed, we have 3 local talks + 1 overflow. I'll confirm AV needs. @Rae please confirm stage slot order.
Rae - Events: Got it. AV: 1 lav, 1 projector. Stage slots 10:30, 12:00, 2:30, overflow 4:00. I'll slot em after lunch.
Tom Ops: Swag inventory update:
```
T-shirts: 120 (S:30 M:40 L:30 XL:20)
Stickers: 600
Notebooks: 150
USBs: 0 (out)
Pins: 200
```
Matt S: We should reorder USBs or replace with QR-guides. USBs slower to ship. Budget ok?
Carla (Mktg): Replace with foldable guide cards + QR for benchmark reports and webinar sign-up. Link for lead capture -> https://forms.gle/riverside-leads
Jin L: I'll make a short bench narrative flier with 3 bullet points: latency/cost, dedicated vs hosted, real app case study. Send to design by 3pm.
Rae - Events: Who's owning the QR routing in Slack->CRM? We want tag: "riverside-webinar-2026" then auto to HubSpot. @Tom Ops?
Tom Ops: I can wire the Zap. Need the form field names and the fallback email. Also shipping address:
Riverside Community Center
Attn: Redwood Booth
123 River Ave
Riverside, CA 91000
ETA Monday morning preferred.
Carla (Mktg): Great. Matt, order 150 guide-cards, 150 name badges, and a small extra of shirts (20) for staff. PO 44321.
Matt S: PO submitted. Expected ship Fri. :thumbsup: 
swag-bot: Reminder: swag reorder threshold reached for USBs replacement items. Suggested vendor: printfast.co/express
Jin L: Webinar tie-in plan: 1) post-meetup webinar 2 weeks after (deep dive + demo), 2) invite all leads with segment labels. Draft copy:
"Missed the demo at Riverside? Join our deep dive on cost-aware inference with live Q&A."
Carla (Mktg): Love it. CTA to the lead form and webinar landing page. Draft landing page -> https://redwood.ai/riverside-webinar
Rae - Events: Onsite staffing: Carla, Matt, Jin, Rae, plus two contractors (Jesse, Priya). Shift schedule coming.
Tom Ops: I'll post tracking numbers once label created. Also suggest packing list code for volunteers:
```
- 2x tables
- 1x tablecloth (branded)
- 1x banner
- AV kit
- swag boxes
- laptop + HDMI
```
Carla (Mktg): Final ask — everyone confirm by EOD. If no objections, I'll lock copy and shipping.
Matt S: Confirmed :shipit:
Jin L: Confirmed
Rae - Events: Confirmed
Tom Ops: Confirmed
Carla (Mktg): Thanks all! I'll push the benchmark flier to #design now. :rocket:
